correctness.rationale: For smooth complex complete-intersection threefolds of codimension c>=2 and degrees d_i>=2 with m=S-c-4>0, adjunction gives K=O(m). Lefschetz h^01=h^02=0 and HRR give p_g=1+m(prod d_i)(m^2+sum d_i^2-c-4)/48. A balancing step a<b-1 multiplies its change by mP delta/48 times R-2ab-2delta; substituting r=c-2,u=a-2,t=b-a-2 and remaining d_j=2+w_j gives exact nonnegative polynomial except for codim2 baseline controlled by m>0. Exactly (2,5),(3,5),(2,2,4) yield zero, with equalities and global balanced maximum/one-heavy minimum. Independently expanded the symbolic polynomial for r=0..4 and checked representative Hilbert-series coefficients against HRR; these finite checks are supplementary to all-c,S factorization.
